description: This file defines the ScriptTagHelper class, a Razor TagHelper for managing script resources in ASP.NET Core projects, including registration, inline content, dependencies, and rendering logic.

classes.name: ScriptTagHelper
classes.description: A Razor TagHelper for managing script tags, including resource registration, dependencies, inline content, and rendering.

methods.name: ProcessAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the script tag, handling different scenarios such as external URLs, named resources, inline scripts, and custom script content.

methods.name: PopulateResourceDefinition
methods.description: Populates a ResourceDefinition object with properties like URL, CDN, cultures, dependencies, version, and append version flag.

methods.name: PopulateRequireSettings
methods.description: Sets various RequireSettings based on the tag helper's properties, such as location, CDN usage, condition, debug mode, and culture.

methods.name: RenderScript
methods.description: Renders the script resource using the resource manager and appends it to the output.
